regulations.regulation_name: Escape route through the storey height
regulations.description: The escape route should be more than 4.5m above the ground level.

regulations.regulation_name: Protected wall enclosures within the room or space
regulations.description: The protected enclosure in a storey should have a height of 4.5m above the ground level
The storey should be at a height of 7.5m above the adjacent ground level and have an alternative exit route.
regulations.doc_reference: Section 2.9.6-Escape within dwellings with alternative exits

regulations.description: The windows should be situated in an external wall or roof and be large enough to escape and have an unobstructed openable area that is atleast 0.33m2.
regulations.doc_reference: Section 2.9.4- Escape within dwellings with escape windows

regulations.regulation_name: Fire suppression system in the buildings
regulations.description: The fire system is mandatory in every building design in an event of an immediate fire outbreak inside the building.
To help all the evacuees reach the nearest escape stair, the travel distance within the lobby is limited to 10m.

regulations.regulation_name: Escape route from the nearest stair serving the basement storey
regulations.description: The stair serving the basement storey should be separated from the ground storey and have an alternate window or exit to escape out.
The space area of an individual storey having more than 200m2 cannot follow the standard fire safety guidance.
regulations.doc_reference: Section 2.9.1-Escape within dwellings with general principles

regulations.regulation_name: Possible sscape routes from protected zones
regulations.description: The external wall adjoining the protected wall protecting the zone near the final exit should not be more than 2m.

regulations.regulation_name: The escape route using external stairs
regulations.description: The external escape stair should not serve a building where the topmost storey height is more than 7.5m above the adjacent ground.
regulations.doc_reference: Section 2.9.22-Escape route having external escape stairs
